_comment: Canonical LTR feature schema. Full-system rebuild required when reordered. Run `make regen-feature-schema` and `make check-feature-parity` after editing.

features.name: bm25_score
features.description: BM25 raw score

features.name: bm25_rank
features.description: BM25 rank within query; absent encoded as max observed rank + 1

features.name: title_bm25_score
features.description: Named BM25 contribution from the title field

features.name: category_path_bm25_score
features.description: Named BM25 contribution from the category path field

features.name: category_bm25_score
features.description: Named BM25 contribution from the leaf category field

features.name: bullets_bm25_score
features.description: Named BM25 contribution from the bullet text field

features.name: description_bm25_score
features.description: Named BM25 contribution from the description field

features.name: brand_bm25_score
features.description: Named fuzzy BM25 contribution from the brand field

features.name: knn_score
features.description: k-NN cosine similarity

features.name: knn_rank
features.description: k-NN rank within query; absent encoded as max observed rank + 1

features.name: rrf_score
features.description: RRF fused retrieval score

features.name: popularity_prior
features.description: Catalog popularity prior in [0,1]

features.name: price_log_cents
features.description: log1p(price_cents)

features.name: title_length_tokens
features.description: Token count of title

features.name: query_length_tokens
features.description: Token count of query

features.name: query_has_brand
features.description: Query contains a known brand token

features.name: query_has_color
features.description: Query contains a known color token

features.name: query_has_category_token
features.description: Query contains a known category token

features.name: query_has_size_pattern
features.description: Query contains size/unit pattern

features.name: query_gender_intent
features.description: Requested gender: 0=none, 1=men, 2=women, 3=boys, 4=girls, 5=unisex

features.name: product_gender
features.description: Derived product gender from indexed gender, category path, or title

features.name: gender_intent_match
features.description: Query gender match strength; unisex products partially match men and women

features.name: gender_intent_mismatch
features.description: Known query gender differs from product gender

features.name: product_brand_match
features.description: Query brand token matches product brand

features.name: product_brand_token_overlap
features.description: Fraction of product brand tokens present in query

features.name: product_color_match
features.description: Query color token matches product color

features.name: title_query_token_coverage
features.description: Fraction of non-brand query tokens present in title

features.name: category_query_token_coverage
features.description: Fraction of non-brand query tokens present in category path

features.name: product_category_token_overlap
features.description: Fraction of product category tokens present in query

features.name: title_exact_query_match
features.description: Normalized full query appears in normalized title

features.name: user_brand_affinity
features.description: User brand click-share in [0,1]

features.name: query_affordability_intent
features.description: Query asks for affordable, cheap, budget, value, or low-cost products

features.name: affordability_price_score
features.description: Low-price score active only for affordability-intent queries; larger means cheaper

features.name: brand_family_match
features.description: Query brand/subbrand intent matches product brand family without broadening to unrelated family products

features.name: subbrand_title_match
features.description: Query brand/subbrand alias appears in product title
